Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor

Class FormatTools

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor.FormatTools
All Implemented Interfaces:
TextEditorExtension
public final class FormatTools extends Object implements TextEditorExtension
The bundled "Formatting Tools" extension: whitespace and line-ending clean-up for source files, registered through the public TextEditorExtension SPI and grouped under the Code category alongside CodeTools. It converts between tabs and spaces and normalises line endings to Unix (LF) or Windows (CRLF).

Every operation is a pure String -> String function exposed as a static for headless unit tests; the toolbar actions pipe the whole document through the matching function and write it back, so a no-op result never dirties the document.
